summary: Emera Inc. filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer, attaching a media release declaring regular quarterly dividends on its common and eight series of preferred shares. The common dividend is $0.73250 per share, payable August 17, 2026 to holders of record August 3, 2026. The release corrects a clerical error in the Series J rate from the July 13 press release but otherwise confirms routine dividend declarations. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is announced. This is a routine dividend declaration and not a special situation.
